summary: A cat-shaped children's toy keyboard modelled on B. toys' Meowsic, with the toy's front panel drawn on screen, plus the arpeggiator and six-track sequencer from LAX-32. Docs are in French.
features: Five sounds: piano, bells, organ, banjo and a synthesized meow
Five rhythms, 20 nursery tunes and 7 meowed cat songs
50-note recorder with playback; toy speaker effect knob
Six 64-step tracks, four patterns, chance, conditions and ratchets
MIDI: keyboard on channel 1, each sound on 2-6, drums on 10

headings: miaou — le clavier-chat pour m-vave fm-1
